sqlite.target: existing flight_sqlite / flight::sqlite STATIC; one verified amalgamation compiled into separate storage DLL
sqlite.include: same checksum-verified amalgamation sqlite3.h; no OS sqlite DLL or unpinned package
sqlite.VFS: Pinned default win32 only for production; verify sqlite3_file_control(SQLITE_FCNTL_VFSNAME) and record observed name. Exclusive OS ownership and PRAGMA locking_mode=EXCLUSIVE before database/WAL access, as protocol. sqlite3_open_v2 SQLITE_OPEN_EXCLUSIVE is NOT CreateNew; Windows adapter must reserve new DB with real CREATE_NEW before SQLite open without CREATE. No custom VFS added through this allocation.
sqlite.actual_qualification: Record actual sqlite3_sourceid/libversion/compile options/VFS, compiled objects/flags/link map, flush failure and WAL/checkpoint behavior. Static source inspection or THREADSAFE alone does not prove durable operation.
sqlite.C_API_scope: Required bounded repository API inventory, no wildcard load/exec of caller SQL. Bind only fixed reviewed statements and parameters; integer enum/bool/small count use INT, U64 text and float bits use TEXT/BLOB, never sqlite3_bind_double for durable preferences. busy_timeout exactly2000ms per contract; at most one application retry only proved not-begun. sqlite3_free releases SQLite-owned VFS-name buffers. Extra API usage must be source-reviewed before build, not treated as an arbitrary capability.

C_compiler_binding.postcompile: Actual C compile row/compiler path/hash, object bytes, static archive member roster/hash and DLL actual link command/map prove transitive inclusion; changing C compiler/options/defines/CRT changes control identity. No unlinked static library or source-only pin can qualify the DLL.

Full accepted semantic-validator parity, subnormal/negative-zero handling and caller FENV/MXCSR preservation require actual qualification; strict compiler switches alone are not runtime proof.

SHA256 UTF8: flight-local-players-component-v1
 + storage-build-controls:<digest>
 + storage-contracts:<digest>
 + sqlite-source:<verified source ID>
 + sqlite-amalgamation:<raw sqlite3.c digest>
 + sqlite-header:<raw sqlite3.h digest>
 + godot-cpp:<verified commit>
 + ordered component path:<SHA256 LF-normalized source bytes>
 lines. Interpret displayed 
 as actual LF.
storage_identity.build_digest_recipe: Ordered build-control path:<SHA256 LF-normalized text> LF lines, then exact ordered compiled_build_scalar_keys below as key:<value> LF. Values are actual independently inspected configure/cache/compile/link controls, not guessed CXX stand-ins for C. One final LF; no arbitrary environment or generated output. Compiler executable digests are actual file bytes; command/input paths canonicalized only under the explicit command-binding recipe. Storage qualification fails if actual C SQLite compilation/static inclusion disagrees.
storage_identity.contracts_digest_recipe: Ordered contract-input path:<SHA256 exact UTF8 LF file bytes> LF lines. SQL/codec exact raw LF hash must match schema binding; no auto-formatting.
storage_identity.resource_rule: Exactly five UTF8 no-BOM LF lines with final LF. Template an input, generated output excluded from source/control inputs. Compiled definition FLIGHT_LOCAL_PLAYERS_COMPONENT_SHA256 matches independently reproduced digest; shipping read-only C++ accessor performs no Godot/root/DB access. No new LocalPlayers protocol method or use of native echo as expected value.
storage_identity.fresh_hashes: No source, object, library, identity or final binary digest allocated for unwritten files. Before any build, bind actual reviewed source/afterimages, controls, dependencies and references in fresh source packet; after build independently derive and qualify evidence. No zero placeholders/fabricated hashes accepted as current.
storage_identity.command_binding_recipe: Before build freeze compiler/control/source command plan; after compile independently bind actual compile_commands.json SQLite C row, its selected C compiler file/ID/version/options/defines/includes, exact produced object and archive-member roster/hashes, and actual storage DLL link command/map demonstrating inclusion of that object. command hash = SHA256 exact UTF8 LF command record with source/build roots replaced only by fixed @source_root/@build_root tokens, retaining argument array order, exact spelling and compiler file digest; reject ambiguous/duplicate source rows and shell-string-only reconstruction. Object/archive/link hashes are build witnesses used to QUALIFY build digest, not source-fingerprint inputs available only after compile. See build_digest_cycle_policy.
storage_identity.build_digest_cycle_policy: Only pre-compilation scalar/source/control values participate in compiled BUILD_CONTROL_SHA256: actual C/CXX compiler IDs/versions/executable hashes, flags/configuration flags, declared SQLite target options/defines/include provenance, runtime properties, precision/API/platform and intended command recipe. Post-compilation sqlite_c_compile_command_sha256, sqlite_static_archive_sha256, sqlite_object_roster_sha256 and storage_link_command_sha256 are mandatory independently measured build evidence, NOT compiled digest inputs; otherwise source_identity.cpp -> static archive -> DLL creates a cycle. The ordered scalar list is partitioned explicitly below.

ctest_policy: These exact five CTest names/target commands are required for Windows. Any missing/duplicate/extra replacement target or command fails qualification. The qualifier is the already allocated Root runner backend, not a new independent harness; fixed Root-reviewed proof root/authorization substituted as data. Build-only stage never runs CTest/actors. NativeChecks requires explicit authorization and exact actual executable hashes, five discovery commands plus both actor hashes/closed arguments, descriptor/nonce and observed exits. Linux runs local_players_codec only and records remaining four Windows-only gates unavailable; neither absent tests nor core compilation yields Windows green. Test bridge/journey checks are separate actual Godot gates, never renamed CTests.
